cases.detail: Container templates can't run prepare steps. Build your own image FROM an SRW base image and name it in environment.image (see examples/manifests/container-workspace-templates.md).
config_override.workspace.container are no longer supported. Put the image and resources in a WorkspaceTemplate (environment.image, resources) and select it with `workspace`.

sandboxKeyAtJobCreate.detail: config_override.workspace.sandbox are no longer supported. Put the image and resources in a WorkspaceTemplate (environment.image, resources) and select it with `workspace`.

cases.concern: POST /api/persistent/tool-groups/preview (the New Session/Job form preview) returns 200 for config_override.workspace.container and .sandbox: it drops the key with a warning instead of refusing.

cases.method: Temporary LABEL line appended to docker/Dockerfile.workspace (a comment-only change keeps the image digest, so Tilt would not change the tag); reverted with git checkout

observed.pinnedSessionPod: 69e700311f survived the rollout and two reconciler ticks, then its agent ended it (boot_ws_timeout), not drift

cases.note: With tilt-<hash> tags expected_workspace_shas() is empty, so the reconciler skips drift checks for every pod. The check cannot fail here; the label logic is the discriminating evidence.

resolutions.change: A pull-failed Job's creation settles on its never-started Pod, so the Job's terminal cleanup removes the Pod, Service and PVC. Only a fresh create's own volume is settled; a restore or a create over a kept volume keeps its resources.
